probes.check: am_probe_flecs_handles(): entity ids with each of their 64 bits set convert to am::handles::FlecsEntity and back unchanged.

seeded_violation.description: Store entity ids as their 32-bit index, since a lookup needs only that.

adaptation_notes: am::handles::FlecsEntity carries an ecs_entity_t's whole 64-bit value: its generation tells a recycled index from the entity that had it, and ecs_is_alive checks it.
The world owns every entity; glue never keeps an entity id past ecs_fini, and checks ecs_is_alive before using one it kept across frames.
